description: React component for a gym management system's member progress page, allowing users to view and manage exercise logs and body metrics, with API interactions for fetching and updating data.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Main React functional component for displaying and managing exercise logs and body metrics.

methods.name: fetchLogs
methods.description: Fetches exercise logs from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches body metrics from the backend API.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Adds a new exercise log entry via API.

methods.name: deleteLog
methods.description: Deletes an exercise log entry via API.

methods.name: addMetric
methods.description: Adds a new body metric entry via API.
